name: Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial 2024–2030
owner: Presidencia de la República Oriental del Uruguay — AGESIC
description: Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial 2024–2030 (December 2024). National artificial intelligence strategy of Uruguay coordinated by AGESIC, expanding the 2020 Digital Government AI Strategy into a comprehensive national strategy for 2024–2030.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Presidencia de la República Oriental del Uruguay — AGESIC (gub.uy) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Presidencia de la República Oriental del Uruguay — AGESIC (gub.uy).
